note: The gathering stands here · مَحَلُّ الْقِيَامِ

verses.ar: صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدْ ۞ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمْ
verses.en: The blessings of Allāh be upon Muḥammad; the blessings of Allāh and His peace be upon him.

verses.ar: يَا نَبِي سَلَامْ عَلَيْكَ ۞ يَا رَسُولْ سَلَامْ عَلَيْكَ
verses.en: O Prophet, peace be upon you. O Messenger, peace be upon you.

verses.ar: يَا حَبِيبْ سَلَامْ عَلَيْكَ ۞ صَلَوَاتُ اللّٰهِ عَلَيْكَ
verses.en: O Beloved, peace be upon you. The blessings of Allāh be upon you.

verses.ar: أَبْرَزَ اللّٰهُ الْمُشَفَّعْ ۞ صَاحِبَ الْقَدْرِ الْمُرَفَّعْ
verses.en: Allāh has brought forth the accepted intercessor, the possessor of the exalted rank.

verses.ar: فَمَلَا النُّورُ النَّوَاحِي ۞ عَمَّ كُلَّ الْكَوْنِ أَجْمَعْ
verses.en: And the light filled every quarter; it took in the whole of creation entire.

verses.ar: نُكِّسَتْ أَصْنَامُ شِرْكٍ ۞ وَبِنَا الشِّرْكِ تَصَدَّعْ
verses.en: The idols of idolatry were thrown down, and the edifice of idolatry cracked apart.

verses.ar: وَدَنَا وَقْتُ الْهِدَايَةْ ۞ وَحِمَى الْكُفْرِ تَزَعْزَعْ
verses.en: The hour of guidance drew near, and the stronghold of disbelief was shaken.

verses.ar: مَرْحَبًا أَهْلًا وَسَهْلًا ۞ بِكَ يَا ذَا الْقَدْرِ الْأَرْفَعْ
verses.en: Welcome, and welcome again, to you, O possessor of the loftiest rank.

verses.ar: يَا إِمَامَ أَهْلِ الرِّسَالَةْ ۞ مَنْ بِهِ الْآفَاتُ تُدْفَعْ
verses.en: O leader of the people of the message, through whom afflictions are driven away.

verses.ar: أَنْتَ فِي الْحَشْرِ مَلَاذٌ ۞ لَكَ كُلُّ الْخَلْقِ تَفْزَعْ
verses.en: On the day of gathering you are the refuge; to you all creation will flee.

verses.ar: وَيُنَادُونَ تَرَى مَا ۞ قَدْ دَهَا مِنْ هَوْلٍ أَفْظَعْ
verses.en: And they will call out: do you see what has come upon us, of terror most dreadful?

verses.ar: مَرْحَبًا مَرْحَبًا جَدَّ الْحُسَيْنِ ۞ مَرْحَبًا مَرْحَبًا يَا نُورَ عَيْنِي
verses.en: Welcome, welcome, O grandfather of Ḥusayn. Welcome, welcome, O light of my eye.

verses.ar: فَلَهَا أَنْتَ فَتَسْجُدْ ۞ وَتُنَادَى اشْفَعْ تُشَفَّعْ
verses.en: For it you are the one; you will prostrate, and be called: intercede, and your intercession is accepted.

verses.ar: فَعَلَيْكَ اللّٰهُ صَلَّى ۞ مَا بَدَا النُّورُ وَشَعْشَعْ
verses.en: So may Allāh send His mercy upon you, for as long as light appears and spreads its rays.

verses.ar: وَبِكَ الرَّحْمٰنَ نَسْأَلْ ۞ وَإِلَهُ الْعَرْشِ يَسْمَعْ
verses.en: And through you we ask the All-Merciful, and the Lord of the Throne hears.

verses.ar: رَبِّ فَاغْفِرْ لِي ذُنُوبِي يَا اللّٰهْ ۞ بِبَرَكَةِ الْهَادِي الْمُشَفَّعْ يَا اللّٰهْ
verses.en: My Lord, forgive me my sins — O Allāh — by the blessing of the guide whose intercession is accepted — O Allāh.

verses.ar: يَا عَظِيمَ الْمَنِّ يَا رَبّ ۞ شَمِّلَنَا بِالْمُصْطَفَى اجْمَعْ
verses.en: O You of immense bounty, O Lord, gather us all together with the Chosen One.

verses.ar: وَبِهِ فَانْظُرْ إِلَيْنَا ۞ وَاعْطِنَا بِهِ كُلَّ مَطْمَعْ
verses.en: And for his sake look upon us, and through him grant us all that we hope for.

verses.ar: وَاكْفِنَا كُلَّ الْبَلَايَا ۞ وَادْفَعِ الْآفَاتِ وَارْفَعْ
verses.en: And spare us every trial, and drive off the afflictions and lift them away.

verses.ar: صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدْ ۞ صَلَّى اللّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمْ
verses.en: The blessings of Allāh be upon Muḥammad; the blessings of Allāh and His peace be upon him.

verses.ar: وَاسْقِنَا يَا رَبِّ أَغِثْنَا ۞ بِحَيًا هَطَّالٍ يَهْمَعْ
verses.en: And give us to drink, O Lord; come to our aid with a life-giving rain that pours down.

verses.ar: وَاخْتِمِ الْعُمْرَ بِحُسْنَى ۞ وَأَحْسِنِ الْعُقْبَى وَمَرْجَعْ
verses.en: And seal our lives with what is best, and make beautiful the outcome and the return.

verses.ar: وَصَلَاةُ اللّٰهِ تَغْشَى ۞ مَنْ لَهُ الْحُسْنُ تَجَمَّعْ
verses.en: And may the blessings of Allāh enfold the one in whom all beauty was gathered.

verses.ar: أَحْمَدَ الطُّهْرَ وَآلَهْ ۞ وَالصَّحَابَةْ مَا السَّنَا شَعْ
verses.en: Aḥmad the pure, and his family, and the companions — for as long as light shines out.

verses.ar: اللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَيْهِ وَعَلٰى آلِهِ
verses.en: O Allāh, send Your mercy, peace and blessings upon him and upon his family.
